content: Řɛahd n Arebbi ak-d Ibrahim
Řami tuɣa ɣares ɣar Abram tesɛa u-tesɛin n iseggʷusa, iban as-dd SIDI i Abram, inna as: “Necc d Arebbi Amzemmar x kuřci! Uyur zzat i wudem inu uca iři d bnadem ikemmřen!
Necc ad ggeɣ Řɛahd inu jar ayi d cek uca ad cek sskettareɣ s yijj n cckel imɣar.”
Xenni iwḍa Abram x uɣembub nnes uca issiweř AREBBI akides, inna as:
“Xzar, Necc ad ggeɣ Řɛahd inu akidek uca cek ad tiřid d babatsen n waṭṭas n řegnus.
War ittiři isem nnec ɛad ‘Abram’ maca ‘Ibrahim’, minzi Necc ggiɣ cek d babatsen n waṭṭas n řegnus.
Uca Necc ad cek arreɣ ad tegged řɣiǧet aṭṭas s waṭṭas u ad cek arreɣ d řegnus, uca ijeǧiden ad zzayek dd-ffɣen.
Ad ggeɣ Řɛahd inu jar ayi d cek d zzariɛet nnec awarni ac di marra jjiřat nsen, am yijj n Řɛahd i řebda, ḥima ad iřiɣ d AREBBI i cek u i zzariɛet nnec awarni ac.
Ad ac wceɣ, i cek u i zzariɛet nnec awarni ac, tammurt mani tzeddɣed am ubarrani, marra tammurt n Kenɛan d agřa i řebda. Necc ad iřiɣ d AREBBI i nitni.”
Inna AREBBI ɛawed i Ibrahim: “Cek ad teḥḍid Řɛahd inu, cek d zzariɛet nnec awarni ac, di marra jjiřat nsen.
D wa d Řɛahd inu wenni i ɣa teḥḍam jar ayi-dd d kenniw d zzariɛet nnec awarni ac: ittxeṣṣa ad ixten zzaywem marra min iǧan d awtem.
Kenniw ad txetnem aysum n řeɛdařyet nwem uca man aya ad tiři d řeɛřamet n Řɛahd jar ayi-dd d kenniw.
Mmis n tmenya n wussan ad ixten jar awem, mkuř awtem di marra jjiřat nwem, am wenni dd-ixeřqen di taddart nnec am wenni ittwasɣen s nnuqart zi kuř abarrani u war iǧin zi zzariɛet nnec.
Am wenni dd-ixeřqen di taddart nnec, am wenni tesɣid s nnuqart, ittxeṣṣa as ad ixten. Ammu i ɣa yiři Řɛahd inu deg weysum nwem d Řɛahd i řebda.
Aryaz war ixtinen, wenni řeɛdařyet nnes war tt xtin, aryaz nni ittxeṣṣa ad t qessen zi řgens nnes, aqa yarẓa Řɛahd inu.”
Inna AREBBI ɛawed i Ibrahim: “I Saray tamɣart nnec war d as třiɣid ɛad ‘Saray’, maca ‘Sara’ d wa i ɣa yiřin isem nnes.
Minzi ad tt barkeɣ u zzayes ad ac wceɣ mmic. Wah, ad tt barkeɣ uca nettat ad tedweř d řegnus u ijeǧiden n řegnus ad zzayes dd-ffɣen!”
Xenni iwḍa Ibrahim x uɣembub nnes uca iḍḥec, inna deg wuř nnes: “Aryaz n mya n iseggʷusa ma ad as dd-ittwaxřeq mmis? U Sara, tenni ɣar iǧa tesɛin n iseggʷusa, ma ɛad ad dd-taruw?”
Inna Ibrahim i AREBBI: “Mři Ismaɛil iddar qibač i wudem nnec!”
Maca AREBBI inna: “Lla, ɛad Sara, tamɣart nnec, d tenni d ac dd ɣa yarwen aseymi, uca cek ad as třaɣid Isḥaq. Necc ad ggeɣ Řɛahd inu akides d Řɛahd i řebda, i zzariɛet nnes awarni as.
Zi jjihet n Ismaɛil, aqa seǧeɣ ac. Xzar, Necc barkeɣ t uca ad t arreɣ ittaruw řɣiǧet u ad t arreɣ d aṭṭas. Tenɛac n řḥukkam i dd ɣa yejj, ad t ggeɣ d ijj n řgens imɣar.
Maca ad ggeɣ Řɛahd inu ak-d Isḥaq, wenni i d ac dd ɣa taruw Sara di řweqt-a, deg useggʷas i dd ɣa yasen.”
Umi ikemmeř awař nnes akides, igeɛɛed AREBBI, iggʷej x Ibrahim.

Iksi Ibrahim mmis Ismaɛil d marra isemɣan i dd-ittwaxeřqen di taddart nnes d marra inni immesɣen s nnuqart, marra min iǧan d awtem jar aytbab n taddart n Ibrahim uca ixten řeɛdařyet nsen deg wass nni am mammec d as inna AREBBI.
Tuɣa ɣar Ibrahim tesɛa u-tesɛin n iseggʷusa umi ixten deg weysum n řeɛdařyet nnes.
Igga mmis Ismaɛil třeṭṭac n iseggʷusa, umi t xetnen deg weysum n řeɛdařyet nnes.
Ixten Ibrahim d mmis Ismaɛil deg wass d ijjen.
Xetnen akides marra iryazen n taddart nnes, inni dd-ittwaxeřqen di taddart nnes uřa d inni immesɣen s nnuqart zeg ubarrani.

footnotes.text: Amzemmar x kuřci- wenni ɣares tizemmar x marra min iǧan.
Saray- ad taɣ isem-a wanita ixs ad yini ‘yeǧis n ujeǧid’ (‹’amira’›), maca ɛlaḥsab inneɣni ‘tamɣart imeḥden’. Sara- isem-a wanita ixs ad yini ‘tajeǧidt’ niɣ ‘yemmatsen n řegnus’.
Isḥaq- isem wanita ixs ad yini ‘netta iḍeḥḥec’.

tesɛa u-tesɛin n iseggʷusa- man aya ixs ad yini belli Isḥaq ittwaxeřqed-dd umi tuɣa Ibrahim ɛad ittwaxten (Amz. 18:10-14 d 21:5), aqa-t awarni řami igga Arebbi řɛahd nnes akides (xzar Amz. 17:21). Maca Ismaɛil ittwaxřeq-dd qbeř mma igga Arebbi řɛahd nnes ak-d Ibrahim.
zeg ubarrani- s Tɛibranit ‘zi mmis n ubarrani’.
